title: About Unsolved Problems in Stabilization of Two Coupled Controlled Inverted Pendulums under Stochastic Perturbations
content: To readers attention two known theorems on the stabilization of a controlled inverted pendulum under stochastic perturbations in the form of a combination of white noise and Poisson's jumps are presented. As unsolved problems, a generalization of these theorems is proposed for a mathematical model, described two coupled controlled inverted pendulums.
